svg.title: Double pendulum accuracy against the closed form and MuJoCo
svg.desc: Position error of the pendulum's outer link, as a percent of the arm's reach, over 20 seconds of a 30-degree swing at a 2 ms step, measured against the closed-form equations of motion integrated to 1e-13 tolerance. With semi-implicit Euler, Achilles and MuJoCo have the same error, 0.06 to 0.25 percent, which is the method's own. With RK4, MuJoCo in double precision stays near 1e-8 percent, and Achilles in single precision grows from 2e-4 to 5e-3 percent, about 65 micrometres on a 1.4 metre arm: float32 round-off. Achilles and MuJoCo differ from each other by that same amount.
svg.text: outer-link position error vs closed form (% of reach, log scale)
